items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewer describes an event involving Wild Bill and Bunk Johnson. The interviewee (Jerry Blumberg) does not mention Wild Bill, nor does he claim any personal interaction or relationship with him. He only responds to the interviewer's narrative about Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that's a trouble. A lot of the people around New York happened to come in on the night when Bunk was sitting up there practically snoring. Yeah.

I can remember that one picture. There's a famous picture that Ouija took, I believe, published in one of his books, where Bunk is sound asleep and slept after the first, maybe, set or the second set anyway. He went to sleep on the stand and sat there until the whole dance was over. And Wild Bill happened to be there and he played and sat within about a yard of him, blowing right straight at him just for fun or for meanness or something. And Bunk never heard him. I'm sure it wasn't just entirely an act, although…
He used tincture of myrrh. That's what he gave me a bottle. What was that? And I had a bottle up until recently, the bottle he gave me.
